heading: Help Send Mike to Congress

heading: Tampa Bay's Fighter for Opportunity and Lower Costs
text: Mike Beltran grew up in Brooklyn, New York. After graduating from Harvard Law at the height of the Great Recession, Mike moved to Florida like so many others looking for opportunity. After years of serving his community as a lawyer, Mike felt called to public service and served for six years in the Florida House of Representatives. In the legislature, Mike made a name for himself as someone who stood his ground against both parties, refusing to go along with a bad idea just because his party suggested it.

heading: Tampa Bay's Fighter for Opportunity and Lower Costs
text: In just six years, Mike helped deliver the largest tax cut in Florida history, putting money back in the pockets of Tampa Bay families dealing with historic inflation, expanded healthcare access to pave the way for lower costs on prescription drugs and new hospitals and clinics across Florida, while preserving our rights and values.

heading: Tampa Bay's Fighter for Opportunity and Lower Costs
text: Now Mike is running for Congress to retire Kathy Castor and be that same champion for lower costs, lower taxes, and increased healthcare access, to ensure Tampa Bay remains the greatest place to live and raise a family in the country.

heading: Lower Healthcare Costs & Expand Access
text: Tampa Bay families shouldn't have to drive an hour or take a day off work to see a doctor. Mike broke up healthcare bureaucracies that blocked new clinics from opening and expanded telehealth access so affordable, high-quality care is available to everyone, especially working families and seniors. He'll bring that same fight to Congress.

heading: Lower the Cost of Living & Keep More of What You Earn
text: While Joe Biden and Kathy Castor spent trillions and stuck families with the bill, Mike was delivering real relief: tax holidays on gas and everyday purchases, and the largest tax cut in Florida history. The average Tampa Bay family lost $28,000 to Biden-Castor inflation. In Congress, Mike will cut the wasteful spending that drives prices up and keep your money in your pocket.

heading: Grow Jobs & Remove Barriers to Opportunity
text: Government shouldn't stand between hardworking people and a good career. Mike eliminated red tape that blocked qualified workers from starting jobs and small businesses from growing. In Congress, he'll fight to reduce the regulations that raise costs and limit opportunity for Tampa Bay families and businesses.

heading: Protect Our Community From Overreach
text: Lobbyists in Washington shouldn't be making decisions that belong to Hillsborough County. Mike will fight to ensure no data center is built in our community without local approval and a guarantee it won't raise your energy bills or harm our environment. Our community's future should be decided here, not in DC.

heading: A Fighter for Families, Not a Career Politician
text: Mike isn't looking for the next rung on the ladder. He's a husband, father of two, and an attorney who built his life here in Tampa Bay. In the legislature he voted against his own party when they were wrong, and he'll do the same in Congress: putting Tampa Bay families first, not politicians.

heading: Taking the Florida Way to Congress
text: Mike Beltran delivered solutions in Tallahassee while Kathy Castor made our lives harder and more expensive. Mike has a plan to change that in Congress.

heading: Ban Congressional Stock Trading
text: Public service should not create opportunities for personal financial gain. From the start, Mike has supported banning members of Congress from trading individual stocks and strengthening transparency and accountability rules to help prevent conflicts of interest and protect public trust. Meanwhile, Rep. Kathy Castor has admitted to individual stock trading with no safeguards.

heading: Ban Congressional Stock Trading
text: These rules should apply to everyone, regardless of party. Public service should be about serving the people, and Washington needs clear, enforceable standards that put accountability first.

heading: Support Our Veterans & Military
text: The men and women who served this country earned every benefit and every right they were promised. Mike will fight to ensure our veterans receive the care, resources, and respect they deserve. He supports a strong national defense and a military that is focused on protecting America, not advancing political agendas.

heading: School Choice & Parental Rights
text: Parents know what is best for their children. Mike championed school choice in Tallahassee, giving families the freedom to choose the school and education that works for them. He'll bring that fight to Washington and stand against any effort to cut parents out of decisions about their children's education and values.

heading: Secure the Border
text: Mike stands 100% with President Trump on immigration. We need to finish the wall, deport the criminals and fraudsters, and restore law and order at our southern border. Florida's families deserve security, not an open-border disaster.

heading: Back Law Enforcement
text: Our police officers and first responders put themselves on the line every day to keep Tampa Bay safe. Mike stands firmly behind law enforcement and will oppose any effort to defund, undermine, or politicize the men and women who protect our communities.

heading: Defend the Second Amendment
text: Mike has a perfect pro-gun record. No red flag laws, no magazine bans, no compromise. The Second Amendment is absolute and Mike will fight to keep it that way in Congress.

heading: Protect Life
text: Mike has always fought to protect life. He believes Dobbs was correctly decided and that states, not Washington bureaucrats, judges, or politicians, should set their own policies that include exceptions for rape, incest, and the life of the mother.

heading: Safeguard Our Elections
text: Our elections should be the cleanest and most secure in the entire world. We need to pass the SAVE America Act to ensure only American citizens vote in our elections, mandate photo ID, and purge noncitizens from voter rolls. Every American citizen deserves to have their voice heard in our elections, and if we let fraud or illegal votes flood the system, then the voices of Americans are diluted.
